gaps.what: No area or extent on the page; Cliopatria's 1612-1705 outline (14.9k km2) is half the size of the same state's shapes before and after (27.6k, 31.4k) and cannot be settled. Shah Ismail's capture of Tbilisi (1522 or 1524) has no end date and is not ledgered.

Dates of the independence of Mingrelia, Abkhazia and Guria from Imereti; Racha, Lechkhumi, Svaneti and Ottoman-fort history; Cliopatria changes of 1700, 1721, 1775 and 1803 (all under 2%) unexplained; ruler strip not written (table partly read).

Hereti, Saingilo, Tusheti and Pshavi borders and transfers with Shirvan and Dagestan; the year of Levan's restoration on the Kakheti page; the Iranian occupation of 1736-1744 is a bridging reading (confidence 1); the Elisu Sultanate successor has no land.

Cliopatria shape changes of 1727 (-1,540 km2), 1788 (+1,570) and 1811 (-380) are recorded at confidence 1 with Ottoman and Russian counterparts as readings; the 1700 transfer from Mingrelia is undated; the Abkhaz-Mingrelian border conflicts are undated; the status of Sukhumi after the 1810 storming is not on the page.
The 1507-1515 shape that reaches into Turkey is unexplained; the year of the Kobuleti detachment (within 1768-1774) and of the 1811 shape change are not on the page.

The Mingrelia article has no history sections: only 1463, 1557, 1803, 1867, 1868 are dated. The 1727 coast loss and the 1775/1788 changes are Cliopatria artefacts without a page; the Ottoman relationship is undated; the infobox's 1463 against the text's 1557 is unreconciled.

problems: Cliopatria's 'Kingdom of Georgia' rows 1468-1578 (27.6k km2) and 1706-1762 (31.4k km2) are Kartli, not the whole kingdom (they border Imereti and Kakheti; the 1763 row grows by about Kakheti's area). kingdom-of-kartli points new keyframes at those shapes; the owner of kingdom-of-georgia (another part of eu-19) must not draw the same geometry for the same years.

Cliopatria's 'Kingdom of Kartli' 1463-1467 shape (130,082 km2) is the whole unified Georgia and overlaps the shapes the five successors start in 1468; marked wrong, years belong to kingdom-of-georgia. kingdom-of-kartli therefore starts in 1478, as the page's infobox does.

Cliopatria starts Imereti, Mingrelia, Guria, Abkhazia in 1468 (infoboxes: 1463) and Kakheti in 1468 (infobox 1466), and has no shape for 1579-1611 for any of them (probably covered by its Ottoman row); new keyframes carry the 1468/1572 shapes through those spans. Mingrelia (Cliopatria to 1810, page to 4 January 1867) and Abkhazia (1829 against November 1864) also get new keyframes carrying the last shape forward as Russian vassals; Cliopatria's Russian Empire row may already contain that land.

Vassal events belong to the suzerain's dossier; the dates (Persian and Ottoman suzerainties over Kartli and Kakheti 1555-1747, Imereti's Ottoman vassalage from 29 May 1555 and Russian from 25 April 1804, Guria's tribute from 13 December 1614 and Russian suzerainty from 19 June 1810, Mingrelia 1803-1867, Abkhazia 1810-1864) are listed in history/polities/_notes/eu-19-e.md for the ottoman-empire, safavid-dynasty, afsharid-iran and russian-empire dossiers. Imereti's own suzerainty over Guria, Abkhazia and Mingrelia is ledgered in kingdom-of-imereti.

Occupation events are written in the occupied state's dossier with the occupier as counterpart (the schema's 'roles reversed'): Kartli 1578-1604 and 1723-1736, Kakheti 1724-1736 and 1736-1744, Imereti 1765-1767. Flip them if the renderer reads the other way.

Page budgets exceeded: kingdom-of-kartli 5 pages (budget 1-2), kingdom-of-imereti 9 (budget 5, four only for vassal dates), principality-of-abkhazia and principality-of-mingrelia 6 (budget 5). Pages were reused across dossiers, so 18 distinct pages were opened in all.

None of the six articles gives an infobox area, so no area comparison could be made. Several shape changes of the three western principalities (1727, 1775, 1788, 1811) are explained by no opened page and are recorded at confidence 1 or left as 'unverified: page silent'.
